extracted.name: Crème Fraiche
extracted.description: This is very much like sour cream yet it is softer and has a little more tang. Use it to garnish anything from pies to soup. Try whipping it with a little bit of sugar for tangy whipped cream!
instruction_lines: Mix together buttermilk and heavy cream. Let sit at room temperature for six to eight hours.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 24 hours before serving.
